title: Cancer Emoji ♋ Meaning: Zodiac Crab, Not the Disease
description: The ♋ Cancer emoji is the zodiac sign of the Crab (June 21 to July 22). It is not a symbol for the illness. See its uses, its 69 joke, and its meme history.
summary: The ♋ Cancer emoji is the astrological symbol for Cancer, the Crab, covering birthdays from about June 21 to July 22. It refers to the star sign, not the disease. Because the glyph resembles the number 69, it is also used as a sexual joke.
meaning: ♋ belongs to the zodiac set. The two curled shapes are usually explained as a crab's claws, and the sign they represent begins at the June solstice. People born in that window use the emoji in bios, birthday posts, and horoscope talk. In astrology Cancer is a cardinal water sign ruled by the Moon, described as protective, sentimental, and attached to home.

The meme version of a Cancer cries at commercials, remembers what you said three years ago, and would rather host than go out. Fans of the sign use ♋ to own that softness, often with 🌙 or 🥺. "Sorry, I'm a Cancer ♋" excuses a mood swing or a wave of nostalgia, playing on the idea that the Moon keeps their emotions on a tide.

Two unrelated meanings ride on the symbol's shape and name. Rotated, the glyph looks like 69, so it is used as a visual pun for that sex position, particularly in suggestive comments. And during the ironic meme era of the mid-2010s, posters spammed ♋ to label content as "cancer," internet slang for something painfully bad. That usage has faded and was always crude.

The emoji is not an awareness symbol for the illness. Health campaigns and people sharing a diagnosis use ribbons, most often 🎗️, along with hearts in specific colors. Sending ♋ in that setting can confuse readers or seem flippant, since many will see only the horoscope sign or the joke.

contexts.label: In bios and birthday posts
contexts.body: Late June and July birthdays bring out ♋, frequently beside 🦀 or a moon. In a row of three zodiac emoji it marks one of the person's chart placements. Astrology shops and horoscope pages use it to tag Cancer-season content and sign-themed products.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Friends use it to tease the sentimental one: the person who keeps every ticket stub or tears up at a wedding toast. It also describes wanting to stay in. Among people who know the 69 pun, it may appear as innuendo, so the same emoji can be wholesome or not depending on the chat.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: Astrology accounts post ♋ throughout the sign's season with themes of family and feelings. In older meme communities it survives as an ironic insult. Flirtatious comment threads use it for its numeric lookalike, sometimes to slip past filters that catch the digits.

confusedWith.difference: 🎗️ is the awareness ribbon, the appropriate emoji for cancer the disease and other causes. ♋ refers to the zodiac sign only. For medical news, fundraising, or remembrance, choose the ribbon.
🦀 is the animal, used for seafood, beaches, and feeling crabby, as well as by Cancers as a mascot. ♋ is the abstract astrological glyph and is not used for the creature itself.
☯️ also features two curved halves swirling around each other, but it is a Taoist symbol of balance in black and white. ♋ is a pair of separate hooked shapes on a purple tile.

avoid: Do not use ♋ when talking about a cancer diagnosis or loss; it reads as a horoscope sign and may hurt.
Avoid the old habit of calling things "cancer" with this emoji, which many people find offensive.
Do not send it as a 69 joke to someone who has not invited that kind of humor.
design: Two white shapes, each a small circle with a tail sweeping around the other, sit on a purple square. Drawn sideways like this they resemble the digits 6 and 9 lying down. The design is stable across major platforms, sharing the purple tile used for all zodiac signs.

faqs.q: Is ♋ the emoji for cancer the disease?
faqs.a: No. It is the zodiac sign named after the Latin word for crab. The illness shares that name, but the emoji is not used for it. People typically use 🎗️ for cancer awareness and support.

faqs.q: Why do people use ♋ to mean 69?
faqs.a: The glyph looks like a 6 and a 9 nested together. That resemblance makes it a handy visual pun for the sex position, and it sometimes replaces the number in suggestive posts.
About June 21 to July 22. The sign starts at the June solstice, and the precise days vary slightly by year. It comes after Gemini and before Leo.
Usually the star sign, in astrology videos and birthday content. In comments it can be the 69 joke. Which one applies is typically obvious from the video and the tone of the thread.
